messages:
Alex Chen: ok team — planning sync for Q3/Q4 infra buys. goal: meet product request for APAC region + hit fleet utilization OKR of 75% for Dedicated by EOY. need decisions on SKU mix, reserved vs on-demand split, and pilot timeline. thoughts?

Maria Lopez: customers in APAC (2 enterprise deals) asked for regional latency SLA by July. SG region preference. vendors quoted both A100-80GB and H100-80GB options. H100 lead times look nasty (~12-16 weeks). budget is tight for Q3. @Alex any hard date from sales? :calendar:

Alex Chen: sales says earliest contract start = 2026-07-15, can be nudged 2 weeks. primary constraint is provisioning time + network setup.

Raj Patel: pushing forecast numbers — we should size for p95 demand not mean. quick snapshot:
```
week,reqs_per_min,avg_tokens
2026-07-20,130,420
2026-08-03,210,510
2026-09-07,320,610
```
That suggests 2x current Dedicated capacity by early Sep unless rolling rollout. recommends staged ramp: pilot (SG) -> region expansion -> cross-region failover.

Kevin O'Hara: from cost POV, H100 reduces latency for long-context, but A100 is fine for most workloads. proposal: reserve 25% of expected steady state (commit discounts), keep 50% on-demand for growth, and reserve 25% as spot/burst for transient peaks. keeps budget flexible. also consider mixing cheap quantized instances for embedding-heavy routes.

Sarah Nguyen: ops notes: if we go hybrid (cloud + on-prem for Private), lead time for rack + PDUs is ~10 weeks. also need to validate KMS/network for Private before handover. do we want the Private install in APAC or keep VPC-only first?

Maria Lopez: +1 on VPC-first. private on-prem in APAC adds another procurement and compliance layer that slows launch. recommend VPC in SG and track telemetry for 6 weeks before committing on-prem.

Alex Chen: decision items to vote on: 1) SKU mix: H100-heavy vs A100-heavy 2) Procurement split: 25/50/25 reserve/on-demand/spot 3) Pilot region: SG VPC-first 4) Budget cap for Q3: $420k (capex/commit) 5) Decision due: 2026-04-15. please reply with +1 / -1 / need-more-info.

Kevin O'Hara: +1 on 25/50/25 and SG pilot. prefer A100-heavy with a small H100 pool for latency-sensitive routes.

Raj Patel: +1 on staged ramp, need more data on request tails to justify more H100. request: run 2-week perf-sim with current production traces.

Sarah Nguyen: need-more-info on on-prem timelines and power/cabinet costs. I'll loop infra facilities.

Maria Lopez: +1 on VPC-first SG pilot. will ask sales to push contract start to 2026-07-15 final.

deploy-bot: planning-note: created ticket INFRA-6212 for SG pilot provisioning checklist (owner: Sarah Nguyen).

Alex Chen: great — outcome: SG VPC pilot approved, prefer A100-heavy mix with H100 reserve for latency routes, procurement split 25/50/25, decision deadline 2026-04-15. action owners: Raj -> perf-sim, Sarah -> facilities & ticket follow-ups, Maria -> sales timing, Kevin -> cost modeling + commit negotiation. thanks all :thumbsup:
